description: Multi-source document analysis platform generating structured reports with  configurable detail levels. Supports 7 content types (meeting, study, watch,  training, comparison, technical, audit) and 5 detail levels (flash to exhaustive). Features automatic web enrichment, Perplexity-style source tracking, and  anti-hallucination safeguards. Use when processing meeting transcriptions,  conducting thematic research, summarizing articles, comparing solutions,  creating technical documentation, or user says "résumé", "étude", "CR",  "transcription", "compte-rendu", "veille", "comparatif", "audit", "analyse". Not for audio transcription, translation, agenda generation, or video content.
